Build prompt

Build “Alumni Mentorship Office-Hours Booker” on NeoApps for an alumni program manager. Publish mentors’ 15-minute slots and let invited students book or cancel them. Give invited respondents their own response and the organizer an aggregate view. Include a demo with fictional records.

Acceptance test

Two students pick the same last slot. One booking succeeds and cancellation releases the slot.
